Return a single detailed report. Cite file:line everywhere.

91	 * These are the detail pages you reach FROM a service card, so they light the
92	 * card's own entry.
93	 */

95	  { prefix: "/dashboard/servers", href: "/dashboard/services" },
96	  { prefix: "/dashboard/hosting", href: "/dashboard/services" },
97	  { prefix: "/dashboard/games", href: "/dashboard/services" },

99	];

101	export function activeNavHref(path: string): string | null {
102	  let best: string | null = null;
103	  for (const n of NAV) {
104	    if (path === n.href || path.startsWith(n.href + "/")) {
105	      if (!best || n.href.length > best.length) best = n.href;
106	    }
107	  }
108	  for (const a of NAV_ALIASES) {
109	    if (path === a.prefix || path.startsWith(a.prefix + "/")) {
110	      // An alias is always more specific than the `/dashboard` root it would
111	      // otherwise lose to, and never overrides a real entry that matched.
112	      if (!best || best.length <= "/dashboard".length) best = a.href;
113	    }
114	  }
115	  return best;

# Report — Reviews/UGC + Customer-portal conventions in `/opt/nxeon`

---

## TOPIC A — Reviews / ratings / comments / UGC

### A1. `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-reviews.ts` (128 lines)

A **staff-only, admin-CMS** module. There is **no customer-facing write path** anywhere in it.

- `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-reviews.ts:1` — `"use server"`; imports `db`, `requireArea` (RBAC), `setSetting`, `logEvent`.
- `:12` — `SOURCES = ["INTERNAL","GOOGLE","TRUSTPILOT","HOSTADVICE"]`.
- `:14-23` — zod schema: `author` (≤80), `role` (≤120), `body` (≤2000), `rating` int 1–5, `source`, `approved`, `featured`.
- `:31` `saveReview(prev, formData)` — create-or-update; `await requireArea("platform")` at `:32`. Touches **`db.review`** only (`:54`, `:56`, `:58`).
- `:70` `toggleReviewApproved(id)` — publish/unpublish toggle.
- `:80` `toggleReviewFeatured(id)` — pin to top.
- `:90` `deleteReview(id)` — hard delete.
- `:110` `saveReviewProfileUrls(prev, formData)` — writes three `Setting` rows (`review_url_trustpilot` / `_hostadvice` / `_google`) via `setSetting` (`:113-123`). These gate both the hero badges and the post-purchase review-request email.
- `:25-28` `revalidate()` — revalidates `/admin/reviews` and `/`.

**Models touched: `Review` + `Setting` (indirectly via `lib/settings.ts`). Nothing else.**

Only consumer: `/opt/nxeon/components/admin/ReviewControls.tsx:5-9`, rendered by `/opt/nxeon/app/admin/reviews/page.tsx:1-9`.

---

### A2. Prisma schema UGC models — `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma`

| Line | Model/enum | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| **1259** | `enum ReviewSource` | `INTERNAL`, `GOOGLE`, `TRUSTPILOT`, `HOSTADVICE` |
| **1271** | `model Review` | `id`, `author String`, `role String?`, `rating Int` (1-5), `body String`, `source ReviewSource @default(INTERNAL)`, `approved Boolean @default(false)`, `featured Boolean @default(false)`, `createdAt`. Indexes `@@index([approved, featured])`, `@@index([source, approved])`. **No `userId` — a review is not linked to a customer account at all.** |
| **2302** | `model CardAttachment` | `id`, `cardId`, `card`, filename/storedName/mime/sizeBytes, `kind AttachmentKind @default(FILE)`, `createdAt` |
| **2316** | `model CardComment` | `id`, `cardId`, `card Card @relation(onDelete: Cascade)`, `authorName String @default("")` (free-text, **not** a User relation), `body String`, `createdAt`. Admin project board only. |
| **2404** | `model WorkTaskComment` | `id`, `taskId`, `task WorkTask`, `authorId`, `author User @relation("WorkTaskCommentAuthor")`, `body`, `createdAt`. Staff work-board only. |
| **2416** | `model WorkTaskAttachment` | `id`, `taskId`, `filename`, `storedName`, `mime`, `sizeBytes`, `kind`, `uploadedById`/`uploadedBy User`, `createdAt` |
| **2834** | `model Testimonial` | `id`, `author`, `role String?`, `quote String`, `avatarEmoji String?`, `rating Int @default(5)`, `published Boolean @default(false)`, `sortOrder Int`, `createdAt`. **Admin-entered marketing copy** — no user relation. |
| **3125** | `model Feedback` | `id`, `userId String?` + `user User?`, `kind String` (BUG\|FEATURE), `title`, `body`, `url String?`, `status String @default("NEW")` (NEW\|PLANNED\|IN_PROGRESS\|DONE\|DECLINED), `adminNote String?`, `attachments FeedbackAttachment[]`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. **This is the only real customer-authored UGC model with a triage workflow.** |
| **3144** | `model FeedbackAttachment` | `id`, `feedbackId`, `feedback`, `mime`, `sizeBytes`, `data Bytes` (bytes in Postgres), `createdAt` |
| **3381** | `model ChatAttachment` | visitor chat image uploads, bytes in Postgres |
| **3457** | `model AbuseAlert` | `id`, `serverId`, `userId`, `kind` (BANDWIDTH_SPIKE\|SMTP_ABUSE\|PORT_SCAN\|OTHER), `severity`, `detail`, `metric Json?`, `status` (OPEN\|ACKNOWLEDGED\|RESOLVED\|ACTIONED), `createdAt`, `resolvedAt`. **Infrastructure abuse, not content moderation.** |
| **3661** | `model Improvement` | internal nightly-scan backlog with `status PROPOSED\|APPROVED\|DECLINED\|…`. Not customer UGC. |
| **5681** | `model KbSuggestion` | `question`, `answer`, `category`, `source`, `status pending\|approved\|rejected`. AI-drafted KB answers with a real approve/reject queue. |

**Does NOT exist anywhere in the schema:** `Rating`, `Vote`/`Upvote`/`Like`, `Report`/`Flag`/`ContentReport`, `Moderation`/`ModerationQueue`/`ModerationLog`, `BlogComment`, `ProductReview`, `ServerReview`, `ModReview`. `BlogPost` (`prisma/schema.prisma:2433-2450`) has **no comments relation at all**.

Also relevant, and **unmoderated**: `Server.publicListing Boolean` (`prisma/schema.prisma:968`) and `Server.publicDescription String?` (`:969`), plus a second `publicDescription` at `:3093`.

### A3. Homepage Trustpilot-style badges — **real DB records with a hard-coded demo fallback**

- Homepage: `/opt/nxeon/app/page.tsx:10` imports `ReviewBadges`; mounted at `/opt/nxeon/app/page.tsx:133` (hero) and again at `:293` (passed into `PricingExplorer` as `reviewBadges`).
- Component: `/opt/nxeon/components/marketing/ReviewBadges.tsx`.
  - `:50-89` `realBadges()` — `db.review.groupBy({ by: ["source"], where: { approved: true, source: { in: ["TRUSTPILOT","HOSTADVICE","GOOGLE"] } }, _avg: { rating }, _count: { _all } })` plus the three `getSetting("review_url_*")` values.
  - `:75` — a source only renders as a real badge when it has ≥1 approved review **AND** a configured profile URL.
